scientific_integrity: The full mathematical proof uses exact clique/independent-set thresholds and coordinatewise partial-bijection pebble games. No independent mathematical review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple two-factor rook graphs R(a,b) with a,b at least two in pure adjacency/equality; no counting quantifiers.
Least defining width is relative to the rook-graph family, not all finite graphs.
A general multi-factor product theorem and complete historical priority are not established.
Finite computation tests only stated bounded parameter ranges; all-parameter classification rests on a permanent pebble-game proof.
source_date_integrity: The arXiv posting of the finite-variable graph-logic survey has a verified exact public date of 2010-03-25. The related Gray--Macpherson journal record identifies March 2010 without a verified exact original public day, so no exact day is attributed to that record.
title: Sharp finite-variable classification of rectangular rook graphs
